final: WITH cg AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS venue_id, c.country AS country, AVG(r.round) AS round_avg FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), ctry AS (SELECT country, AVG(round_avg) AS country_avg FROM cg GROUP BY country) SELECT cg.venue_id, cg.country, cg.round_avg, cg.round_avg - ctry.country_avg AS diff FROM cg JOIN ctry ON cg.country = ctry.country ORDER BY (cg.round_avg - ctry.country_avg) IS NULL, (cg.round_avg - ctry.country_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
